title: PlanProposal
description: Arguments of propose_plan. A proposal only: the backend recomputes all prices and totals from the catalogue and stores a draft. Dinner only, so at most one item per day.

week_start.description: The Monday of the planned week (YYYY-MM-DD, Africa/Lagos). The backend rejects other weekdays and past weeks.

items.description: One dinner per day. The backend rejects duplicate days.

note.description: Optional one-line summary shown above the plan. No prices or totals.

meal_id.description: A meal_id returned by search_meals, get_meal or get_vendor in this conversation.

quoted_price_kobo.description: The price the tool returned. The backend only uses it to detect a price change; it charges the catalogue price.

reason.description: One short line tied to the student's preferences. No prices.

reason_refs.description: review_ids backing any claim about taste, portion, service or value. Required if the reason makes such a claim.
